text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High tail latency observed on runtime-prod (ranked) — 95th p99 token latency > 800ms for last 5m. Auto-escalation: paging eng-oncall.
alex: on it, picking up pager. quick summary? any customer-facing errors?
maria: seeing queue depth spike on runtime-worker-3/4, a lot of pending requests stuck in in-flight queue. no 5xxs surfaced yet, but clients report slow streaming.
sara: confirmed. metrics: inflight_count jumped from 40->180 in 2m on that pool. cpu usage ok, GPU memory saturation 70% but kv-cache thrash looks high. logs show repeated OOM retries in model-quantized path.
tim: could be a bad quantization kernel fallback causing longer decode. can we drop noncritical features to reduce per-request work? maybe disable chunked streaming for low-tier routes.
kevin: suggesting live mitigation: 1) soft rate-limit new requests for non-enterprise tenants to 20rps, 2) lower max_inflight from 200->80 on runtime-worker-3 via runtime flag, 3) temporarily disable embedding re-rerank path behind /rerank endpoint for 15m.
alex: +1 on plan, but need approval for global rate-limit change. maria, can you measure customer impact if we throttle low-tier? any high-value customers on that pool?
maria: querying per-tenant routing... looks like 3 customers >95th traffic on that pool: acme-inc (tier:pro), papertrail (enterprise, pinned), and quickchat (starter). acme pinned to dedicated, so unaffected. quickchat & papertrail: papertrail is enterprise and pinned to different pool, so only quickchat (starter) on runtime-worker-3 would see throttles.
sara: good. we can target the rate-limit to tenant label == tier:starter to avoid enterprise impact.
alex: ok do it. please post the exact commands you will run; we'll audit.
kevin: running `redctl runtime set-flag --host runtime-worker-3 --flag max_inflight=80 --reason "mitigate inflight surge"` and `redctl rate-limit add --scope tenant.tier=starter --rps 20 --duration 15m --reason "runtime surge"`
sara: also disabling rerank route: `kubectl patch svc rerank --patch '{"spec": {"selector": {"enabled":"false"}}}' -n runtime-prod` (quick and dirty) — will flip back after stabilization.
alex: hold, prefer using deploy-bot rollback style: `redctl route disable --route /rerank --namespace runtime-prod --duration 15m` so console + audit records it. deploy-bot can you run that?
deploy-bot: Received request by alex to disable route /rerank for 15m. Confirm with `yes` to proceed.
alex: yes
deploy-bot: Disabling route /rerank in runtime-prod — action logged. ETA ~12s.
incident-bot: Action applied: route /rerank disabled (actor: deploy-bot). EventID: ev_20750_rerank_01
kevin: applying rate-limit now.
kevin: `redctl rate-limit add --scope "tenant.tier=starter" --rps 20 --burst 40 --duration 15m --reason "mitigate runtime surge"`
maria: rate-limit took effect. observing request ingress drop of ~65% for starters on that pool. overall inflight trending down to ~90.
sara: flipping max_inflight flag on runtime-worker-3 now.
sara: `redctl runtime set-flag --host runtime-worker-3 --flag max_inflight=80 --reason "mitigate inflight surge"` -> success. worker started shedding older requests per policy.
kevin: noticing some 429s for quickchat, they have a high-sensitivity feature. Alex, want to open a short incident page for customer-impact and notify SE?
alex: yes create a quick incident note and ping SE on quickchat. maria, add time window and affected endpoints.
maria: creating note: "2075009876 - transient latency surge; mitigation: tier:starter rate-limited to 20rps, /rerank disabled, max_inflight reduced to 80 on runtime-worker-3; estimated customer impact: quickchat experienced throttling 10:23:xx-10:38:xx; no enterprise customers impacted." Sharing to #customer-success.
kevin: monitoring: p99 latency dropped from 820ms -> 320ms after changes. throughput stable. KV cache miss rate decreased ~30%.
sara: keep watch for replayed requests from clients; if retry storm appears we might need to increase per-tenant burst or extend window.
alex: good point. set provisional burst to 40 already. let's keep mitigation 15m and reassess in 10m; if stable, gradually restore features.
incident-bot: Reminder: mitigation window ends in 9m 30s. Auto-notify 2m before restore.
tim: can we push a hotfix to quant kernel meanwhile? research suggests a regression in fallback in 13.2.1 -> 13.2.4. if we can roll to 13.2.5 patch it might reduce kv thrash.
alex: prioritize a small patch but do not roll it onto runtime-worker-3 while the mitigation is active; schedule for canary on runtime-worker-7.
kevin: ack. continuing to watch. will update thread with metrics snapshot and when we remove rate-limit/restore route.
maria: p99 now 300-360, inflight ~70. looks stable.
alex: thanks team. if no regression in 10m we'll remove the mitigations in this thread and note the rollback commands.
kevin: preparing restore commands: `redctl rate-limit remove --scope "tenant.tier=starter" --reason "mitigation over"` and `redctl route enable --route /rerank --namespace runtime-prod` and `redctl runtime set-flag --host runtime-worker-3 --flag max_inflight=200 --reason "restore defaults"`
alex: copy. leave incident open until all restored and monitoring shows p99 < 400 for 5m.
sara: will watch and post final state.
deploy-bot: Scheduled re-enable of /rerank blocked until manual confirm.
alex: thanks — handoff to morning oncall if still open. I'm going offline in 8m. Ping me only if customer-impact widens.
incident-bot: Thread note appended: mitigation timeline and actions recorded. Closing note on resolution will be appended when mitigations removed.
